answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit.
